name: HFX detail (post-step high-pass injection)
plain: After the normal step, adds the high-pass of the second-stage x0 prediction (value minus 5x5 box blur) times η and times the raw current sigma, then puts each channel's spatial mean back. The addition is capped at 3% of the latent's RMS, and scaled down for img2img when the first sigma is below 0.7. Because it multiplies by raw sigma, models with large sigmas (SD-style, up to about 14.6) hit the 3% cap at most steps while flow models (sigma ≤ 1) mostly don't. Levels: η 0.10, 0.30, 0.70, 1.50.
math:
Shared hfx base (all ten families): a 2-stage exponential (res_2s-style) step with c2=0.65. Symbols: x latent; σ_i current sigma; σ_{i+1} next; h = ln(σ_i/σ_{i+1}); D(·,σ) model x0 prediction; φ1(h)=(1−e^{−h})/h, φ2(h)=(e^{−h}−1+h)/h²; N steps; i step index.
E1 = D(x,σ_i) − x; X2 = x + h·c2·φ1(c2h)·E1; E2 = D(X2, σ_i e^{−c2 h}) − x.
g_i = clip((i/(N−1) − 0.25)/0.30, 0, 1)   (ramp: off for the first quarter, full from 55%); η_i = η·g_i.
After x ← x + h(b1E1 + b2E2):
c = η_i · G · σ_i · (D2 − box5(D2)), D2 = E2 + x_old, G = min(1, (σ_0/0.7)²); if rms(c) > 0.03 rms(x) scale it down;
x ← x + c, then subtract the new per-channel spatial mean and add back the old one.
x ← x + h(b1 E1 + b2 E2'), b2 = φ2/c2, b1 = φ1 − b2. Last step (σ_{i+1} < 1e-6): x ← D(x,σ_i).

props.extra_model_calls: 1 per step (2 calls per step: res_2s-style base with c2=0.65)
